turns.query: Using N-PORT accession 0001099263-25-004485, take the PIMCO Income Fund's reported USD DV01 maturity buckets as of 2025-09-30 and align them to the same-maturity U.S. Treasury par yields at 3 months, 1 year, 5 years, 10 years and 30 years on 2025-09-30 and 2025-12-31. Report ending minus starting yield changes for all five maturities. For a retrospective first-order scenario, treat a positive reported DV01 as a gain for a one-basis-point decline in its matched yield, hold the reported exposures static, and calculate the signed tenor-summed value change, the gross absolute tenor contribution, the maturity with the largest absolute contribution and its signed contribution, plus the signed total as a percentage of reported net assets. Explain the offset between tenor contributions and the limits of interpreting this proxy as fund performance.
